CNImageRenderingSession.doc: A session for rendering a shallow depth-of-field (SDoF) effect onto still images using Metal.

CNImageRenderingSessionConfiguration.doc: Configuration for a CNImageRenderingSession, specifying the rendering quality and algorithm version.

CNRenderingSessionAttributes.doc: A structure for movie-wide attributes required for proper rendering.

CNRenderingSessionFrameAttributes.doc: Creates an object with the per frame attributes that control the appearance of a single frame of the Cinematic movie.

CNScriptChanges.doc: An object that represents a snapshot of the changes made to a movie script, including the added user decisions and detection tracks.

CNScriptFrame.doc: An object that represents what to focus on, and where to focus, in a given movie frame.

CNCinematicCapabilityNeedsPreprocessing.doc: The cinematic asset needs preprocessing before it can be used

CNCinematicCapabilityRenderable.doc: The cinematic asset can be used without preprocessing

CNDetectionType.doc: The type of object detected, such as face, torso, cat, dog and so on.

CNRenderingQuality.doc: The rendering quality, such as thumbnail, preview, export and so on.

CNResourceStatusNeedsDownloading.doc: Configuration is supported but requires download of resources

CNResourceStatusUnsupportedAsset.doc: The given asset is unsupported on the current build

CNResourceStatusUnsupportedDevice.doc: The device lacks hardware capabilities for the given configuration

CNSpatialAudioContentTypeSpatial.doc: Export settings to generate an asset with spatial audio and effect burned in

CNSpatialAudioContentTypeStereo.doc: Export settings to generate an asset with stereo audio and effect burned in

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleCinematic.doc: Isolates background and foreground sounds and places them in separate stems.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleCinematicBac.doc: Isolates background sounds in a stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleCinematicFor.doc: Isolates foreground sounds in a stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleInFrame.doc: Isolates background from foreground sounds in the camera field of view and places them in separate stems.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleInFrameBackg.doc: Isolates background plus foreground sounds outside the camera field of view in a stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleInFrameForeg.doc: Isolates foreground sounds within the camera field of view in a stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStandard.doc: Produces an unprocessed spatial stem of the original recording. This is the default rendering style.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStudio.doc: Isolates background and foreground in separate stems. Adds a proximity effect to foreground sounds.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStudioBackgr.doc: Isolates background sounds in a stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStudioForegr.doc: Isolates foreground sounds in a stem, and adds a proximity effect.

+minimumTileExtendRectForTileRect:source.doc: Returns the minimum source rect that must be sampled to render tileRect without edge artifacts.

-encodeRenderToCommandBuffer:sourceRGBA:.doc: Encode a command to render a shallow depth of field (SDoF) image to a metal texture

-encodeTileRenderToCommandBuffer:sourceT.doc: Encode a command to render a shallow depth of field (SDoF) image to a metal texture

+isRenderingVersionSupported:.doc: Checks if a given rendering version is supported on the current build

-initWithQuality:.doc: Initialize with the latest rendering version

-initWithQuality:renderingVersion:.doc: Initialize with a specific rendering version.

+loadFromAsset:completionHandler:.doc: Loads the rendering session attributes from an asset asynchronously.

-initWithSampleBuffer:sessionAttributes:.doc: Initializes the rendering frame attributes from a sample buffer read from a Cinematic metadata track.

-initWithTimedMetadataGroup:sessionAttri.doc: Initializes the rendering frame attributes from a timed metadata group read from a Cinematic metadata track.

-initWithDataRepresentation:.doc: Creates a previously saved data representation.

-bestDetectionForGroupID:.doc: The best detection to focus on in a frame among those within the given detection group.

-detectionForID:.doc: The detection in the frame with the given detection ID, if any.

latestRenderingVersion.doc: The version of the newest rendering algorithm

renderingVersion.doc: The primary version number used to render the original Cinematic move that determines compatibility.

fNumber.doc: The f-stop value that inversely affects the aperture used to render the Cinematic image.

focusDisparity.doc: Represents the focus plane at which the rendered image should be in focus.

addedDetectionTracks.doc: All detection tracks added since recording the movie.

dataRepresentation.doc: Persistent data representation of changes for later restoration.

fNumber.doc: The f-stop number to apply to the entire movie.

userDecisions.doc: All active user decisions, including those made at recording time, unless removed.

allDetections.doc: All detections for the Cinematic movie.

focusDetection.doc: What to focus on in a given frame of the movie.

focusDisparity.doc: Where to focus in a given frame of the movie.

time.doc: The time of the focus transition.
